Get BBL / DBBL Season Players

Source: R/scb.R
scb_season_players.Rd

Every player registered in a season: the id crosswalk (season_player_id, real_player_id, season_team_id).

Endpoint: GET https://api.basketball-bundesliga.de/seasons/{season} (DBBL: the same route on https://api-1.dbbl.scb.world).

Usage

scb_season_players(season, league = "bbl")

Arguments

season

(required) Season END year (2026 = 2025-26, the sdv key). Sent to the API as its START-year seasonId (season - 1).

league

(default "bbl") League: bbl (men, easyCredit Basketball Bundesliga, api.basketball-bundesliga.de) or dbbl (women, Toyota Damen-Basketball-Bundesliga, api-1.dbbl.scb.world). The two share one API; game ids overlap, so a game is (league, game_id).

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Every player registered in a season: the id crosswalk (season_player_id, real_player_id, season_team_id). An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py scb_season_players):

col_nametypedescription
leaguecharacterLeague the row belongs to: bbl (men) or dbbl (women); BBL and DBBL game ids overlap, so a game is (league, game_id).
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26), the sdv key; the API's season_id plus one.
season_idintegerThe API's own season key, the START year (2025 = 2025-26); season minus one.
season_player_idcharacterSeason-player id: one player's engagement with one club (kept across seasons while he stays, new after a move; see README). Joins to box-score seasonPlayer.id, action seasonPlayerId and /season-players/{seasonPlayerId}.
real_player_idintegerGlobal person id: the same across clubs and seasons. Joins to realPlayerId everywhere.
season_team_idcharacterSeason-team id; equal to the club teamId in every sample (BBL 2005-2026, DBBL 2024-2026).
first_namecharacterPlayer's given name.
last_namecharacterPlayer's family name.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in scb_seasons().

See also

Other SCB Functions: scb_game(), scb_game_actions(), scb_game_players(), scb_game_teams(), scb_games(), scb_games_recent(), scb_player_statistics(), scb_playoff_games(), scb_playoff_series(), scb_records_per_game(), scb_records_season_averages(), scb_referees(), scb_season_player(), scb_season_teams(), scb_seasons(), scb_standings(), scb_team(), scb_team_rosters(), scb_team_seasons(), scb_team_statistics(), scb_transfers(), scb_transfers_teams()
